manifest.summary: A full-window picker over ~/Pictures/Wallpapers and its sub-folders. It indexes every picture's resolution and fingerprint, hides lower-resolution look-alike copies behind the best one, keeps favourites, and sets a picture as the desktop wallpaper, Forge's wallpaper, or both.

features.name: Index
features.description: Resolution, file size, date and a 256-bit difference hash per picture, cached in ~/.cache/forge/wallpaper-index.json and only re-read when a file changes. Runs niced in the background when the backend starts.

features.name: Hidden copies
features.description: Pictures whose fingerprints are within 12 bits and whose shape matches are one picture; the highest-resolution copy is shown and the rest are hidden (never moved or deleted). 'Show hidden copies' brings them back.

features.name: Favourites
features.description: A star on every tile and in the side panel; favourites sort first and have their own view. Stored in ~/.config/forge/wallpapers.json and shown in the Settings app.

features.name: Set on desktop and/or Forge
features.description: Desktop through the first installed tool in forge_wallpapers.DESKTOP_SETTERS (caelestia, awww, swww). Forge through the shared settings, with the new theme handed to the hub live.

features.name: Browse
features.description: Search, sort by name, resolution, date or file size, filter by shape and minimum resolution, adjustable tile size, and an uncropped preview in the side panel.

known_gaps: Hidden copies are only hidden; nothing is moved or deleted, by choice.
The first index of the whole folder takes a couple of minutes.
